richiami.difetto: The front brake line may contact the front tyre and develop a hole allowing brake fluid leakage
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected machines inspect the front brake line and if undamaged install line guide. If damaged  replace and reroute using 2010 model year brake line.

richiami.difetto: The front flexible brake hose may contact the tyre. If this occurs the brake hose will be damaged and eventually leak fluid.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to examine and where necessary reroute or reroute and replace the front brake pipe.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on affected machines the windscreen which is mounted with rubber nuts may become dislodged or strike the rider whilst the machine is being ridden at high speed. Should either of the foregoing occur control of the machine could be lost.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will have the windscreen remounted using upgraded fastener assemblies.

richiami.difetto: Insufficient lubrication to the fifth journal may lead to the gearbox seizing and the rear wheel locking.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to add an oil jet to the clutch shaft which will increase the lubrication to the fifth gear journal.

richiami.difetto: A result of the vibration at the mounting location and the mis-routing of various wires the bank angle sensor can give a false tip signal which causes the engine to cut out. This could in certain circumstances cause an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to move the bank angle sensor from the original location on the battery tray to the current production location on the seat latch.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT WITHOUT WARNING

richiami.difetto: The side stand pivot bolt may come loose in operation creating a situation where either the bolt or stand may fail during normal usage. This situation can lead to a parked machine falling from its stand.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the original side stand and bolt assembly with redesigned components.
richiami.titolo: SIDE STAND MOUNTING BOLT MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: Certain genuine Buell accessory tall windscreens part numbers 58214-06Y and 58214-06YA have been supplied with fixings that do not exhibit the required durability in use once installed; this could lead to a condition where the screen becomes detached striking or distracting the rider.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the original screen fixings.

richiami.difetto: Due to an incorrectly manufactured side stand pivot bolt the side stand may not move backwards when the weight of the parked machine is removed from it.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will have the side stand pivot bolt replaced.

richiami.rimedio: Fit a throttle cable securing clamp at the fuel injection inlet manifold.

richiami.rimedio: Replace all Pro-Series Competition Handlebars with stock configuration handlebars on all affected vehicles.

richiami.rimedio: Recall affected machines and fit a muffler retention kit.
